test_history: House 3 prefix test results were inspected in M2 and M4. This run is engineering validation, not a fresh final evaluation.
notice: State adaptation leaves power frozen. P1 uses raw power; P2 is the same prediction with scale-down correction and source empirical intervals. Null scores are not zeros.
